cards.example_en: The football team from South Africa stayed in our city.
cards.example_zh: 来自南非的足球队住在我们市里。

cards.example_en: A South African writer visited the school library.
cards.example_zh: 一位南非作家来学校图书馆做客。

cards.example_en: The ship crossed the Atlantic Ocean in eight days.
cards.example_zh: 这艘船用八天横渡了大西洋。

cards.example_en: Sri Lanka lies in the Indian Ocean.
cards.example_zh: 斯里兰卡位于印度洋。

cards.example_en: China faces the Pacific Ocean on its eastern coast.
cards.example_zh: 中国东海岸面向太平洋。

cards.example_en: He spent a year studying in the UK.
cards.example_zh: 他在英国学习了一年。

cards.example_en: Her cousin is studying medicine in the USA.
cards.example_zh: 她表哥在美国学医。

cards.example_en: The history lesson explained when the CPC was founded.
cards.example_zh: 历史课讲了中国共产党是何时成立的。

cards.example_en: We watched a parade by the PLA on National Day.
cards.example_zh: 国庆节我们观看了中国人民解放军的阅兵。

cards.example_en: PRC stands for the People's Republic of China.
cards.example_zh: PRC 是中华人民共和国的英文缩写。

cards.example_en: The UN sends help when a country faces a disaster.
cards.example_zh: 一个国家遇到灾害时，联合国会派出援助。

cards.example_en: UNESCO listed the old town as a world heritage site.
cards.example_zh: 联合国教科文组织把这座古城列为世界遗产。

cards.example_en: The WHO advised students to wash their hands often.
cards.example_zh: 世界卫生组织建议学生经常洗手。

cards.example_en: In politics class we learned what the WTO does.
cards.example_zh: 政治课上我们了解了世界贸易组织是做什么的。

cards.example_en: On Children's Day the school put on a short play.
cards.example_zh: 儿童节那天学校演了一出短剧。

cards.example_en: On the Double Ninth Festival we climbed a hill with grandpa.
cards.example_zh: 重阳节我们和爷爷一起去爬山。

cards.example_en: We eat rice dumplings at the Dragon Boat Festival.
cards.example_zh: 端午节我们吃粽子。

cards.example_en: Labour Day is a holiday, so the museum is free.
cards.example_zh: 劳动节放假，博物馆免费开放。

cards.example_en: Families guess riddles at the Lantern Festival.
cards.example_zh: 元宵节家家户户猜灯谜。

cards.example_en: At the Mid-Autumn Festival we share mooncakes and watch the moon.
cards.example_zh: 中秋节我们分月饼、赏月。

cards.example_en: The square is full of flags on National Day.
cards.example_zh: 国庆节广场上挂满了旗帜。

cards.example_en: We stay up to welcome New Year's Day.
cards.example_zh: 我们熬夜迎接元旦。

cards.example_en: PLA Day on 1 August honours the army.
cards.example_zh: 八月一日建军节是向军队致敬的日子。

cards.example_en: Spring Festival is the most important family holiday in China.
cards.example_zh: 春节是中国最重要的家庭节日。

cards.example_en: On Teachers' Day we wrote cards for our English teacher.
cards.example_zh: 教师节我们给英语老师写了贺卡。

cards.example_en: On Tomb-sweeping Day many families visit their ancestors' graves.
cards.example_zh: 清明节很多家庭去祭祖。

cards.example_en: On Women's Day the class prepared flowers for the teachers.
cards.example_zh: 妇女节那天班级给老师们准备了花。

cards.example_en: Mount Huangshan is famous for pine trees and a sea of clouds.
cards.example_zh: 黄山以松树和云海闻名。

cards.example_en: Mount Qomolangma is the highest mountain in the world.
cards.example_zh: 珠穆朗玛峰是世界最高峰。

cards.example_en: We climbed Mount Taishan at sunrise last October.
cards.example_zh: 去年十月我们日出时登上了泰山。

cards.example_en: The Changjiang River, also called the Yangtze, runs to the sea.
cards.example_zh: 长江，也称扬子江，奔流入海。

cards.example_en: The Great Wall winds over the mountains north of Beijing.
cards.example_zh: 长城蜿蜒在北京以北的群山上。

cards.example_en: The Palace Museum was once the home of emperors.
cards.example_zh: 故宫博物院曾是皇帝居住的地方。

cards.example_en: The Yellow River is called the mother river of China.
cards.example_zh: 黄河被称为中国的母亲河。

cards.example_en: Tian'anmen Square is crowded with visitors on National Day.
cards.example_zh: 国庆节天安门广场挤满了游客。

cards.example_en: Beijing opera, also called Peking opera, uses painted faces.
cards.example_zh: 京剧（也称 Peking opera）使用脸谱。

cards.example_en: We tried Beijing roast duck on the school trip.
cards.example_zh: 学校旅行时我们吃了北京烤鸭。

cards.example_en: On cold nights my family cooks hot pot at home.
cards.example_zh: 寒冷的晚上我家会在家里吃火锅。

cards.example_en: Spring Festival follows the lunar calendar, not 1 January.
cards.example_zh: 春节按农历计算，不是一月一日。

cards.example_en: She cut the mooncake into four pieces for the family.
cards.example_zh: 她把月饼切成四块分给家人。

cards.example_en: Grandma stuck a red paper-cut on the window.
cards.example_zh: 奶奶在窗户上贴了一幅红剪纸。

cards.example_en: The singer wore a blue qipao at the school show.
cards.example_zh: 歌手在学校演出时穿了一件蓝色旗袍。

cards.example_en: Dad put Spring Festival couplets on both sides of the door.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸把春联贴在门的两侧。

cards.example_en: A spring roll is a common snack during Spring Festival.
cards.example_zh: 春卷是春节常见的小吃。

cards.example_en: The Silk Road once linked China with cities far to the west.
cards.example_zh: 丝绸之路曾把中国和西方的城市连在一起。

cards.example_en: Traditional Chinese Medicine, or TCM, uses herbs and acupuncture.
cards.example_zh: 中医（TCM）使用草药和针灸。
